title: How mergers shape galaxy morphology in the IllustrisTNG simulation
summary: How galaxy mergers drive morphological evolution remains an open question. Traditional views hold that major mergers produce elliptical galaxies, while minor mergers form dispersion-dominated components such as galactic bulges. However, more recent work has challenged this simple picture, suggesting a more complex evolutionary scenario. In this study, we use the IllustrisTNG cosmological simulation to investigate how mergers shape galaxy morphology, across a broad range of galaxy masses and merger mass ratios. Our results show that the post-merger galaxy morphology is primarily determined by three factors: collision angle $\overlineθ$, cold gas fraction $f_\mathrm{cold\,gas}$, and pre-merger galaxy morphology $\mathrm{(B/T)_{*,pre}}$. Specifically, spiral-in mergers with large $\overlineθ$ increase the rotational support of the system, allowing the gas to settle into an extended disk. When the system is rich in cold gas, star formation within the newly formed gas disk can further strengthen the disk-dominated structure of the remnant. On the other hand, head-on mergers with small $\overlineθ$ typically disrupt ordered galactic motion, producing more dispersion-supported remnants. Overall, we interpret our results within a unified picture of merger-driven morphological transformation in galaxies.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用IllustrisTNG宇宙学模拟，探讨星系合并如何驱动形态演化，发现合并后的星系形态主要由碰撞角度、冷气体比例和合并前形态三个因素决定，并提出一个统一的合并驱动形态转变框架。
AI.motivation: 传统的观点认为大型合并产生椭圆星系，小型合并形成盘状星系核球，但近期研究对这一简单图景提出挑战，星系合并如何驱动形态演化仍是一个未解之谜。
AI.method: 使用IllustrisTNG宇宙学模拟，在广泛的星系质量和合并质量比范围内，系统研究合并如何塑造星系形态。
AI.result: 合并后星系形态主要由三个因素决定：碰撞角度、冷气体比例和合并前星系形态。螺旋式合并（大碰撞角度）增强系统转动支持，使气体沉降为延展盘面；富含冷气体时，新形成气体盘中的恒星形成进一步强化盘主导结构。正面合并（小碰撞角度）则破坏有序星系运动，产生更偏向色散主导的遗迹。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 星系合并如何驱动形态演化仍是一个悬而未决的问题。传统观点认为，大质量合并产生椭圆星系，而小质量合并形成色散主导的成分，如星系核球。然而，最近的研究对这一简单图景提出了挑战，表明存在更复杂的演化情景。在本研究中，我们利用IllustrisTNG宇宙学模拟，研究星系合并如何塑造星系形态，覆盖广泛的星系质量范围和合并质量比。我们的结果表明，合并后星系的形态主要由三个因素决定：碰撞角 $\overlineθ$、冷气体比例 $f_\mathrm{cold\,gas}$ 和合并前星系形态 $\mathrm{(B/T)_{*,pre}}$。具体而言，具有较大 $\overlineθ$ 的螺旋式合并增加了系统的旋转支持，使气体能够沉降到延展的盘中。当系统富含冷气体时，新形成的气体盘内的恒星形成可以进一步增强残余体的盘主导结构。另一方面，具有较小 $\overlineθ$ 的正面合并通常会破坏有序的星系运动，产生更多色散支持的残余体。总体而言，我们在一个统一的星系合并驱动形态转变图景下解释我们的结果。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于现有摘要，本研究的结论是：星系合并驱动的形态转变可以在一个统一图景下理解，挑战了传统简单的“大质量合并产生椭圆星系”观点，并揭示了合并角度和气体含量等因素在形态演化中的关键作用。

figures.caption_en: Figure 1: Mergers selected from the TNG100-1 simulation. For each merger represented by a gray circle, the horizontal axis shows the pre-merger stellar mass of the primary galaxy, and the vertical axis shows the merger stellar mass ratio. Based on various values of these two parameters, as indicated by the red dashed lines, the total merger sample is further divided into ten sub-samples for detailed analysis. Specifically, the vertical red lines separate five mass bins with \(\log(M_{{*,pre}}[M_{\odot}])\) in the ranges of [ \(9.0,9.5\) ], [ \(9.5,10.0\) ], [ \(10.0,10.5\) ], [ \(10.5,11.0\) ], and \(>11.0\) . The horizontal red line separates major mergers with \(\mu_{*}>1:4\) from minor mergers with \(1:10<\mu_{*}<1:4\) . The number of mergers in each sub-sample is indicated by the black annotations.
figures.caption_zh: 图1：从TNG100-1模拟中选择的合并事件。每个灰色圆圈代表一个合并，横轴表示主星系合并前的恒星质量，纵轴表示合并恒星质量比。根据这两个参数的不同值，如红色虚线所示，总合并样本进一步分为十个子样本进行详细分析。具体而言，垂直红线将五个质量区间分开，其中 \(\log(M_{{*,pre}}[M_{\odot}])\) 的范围为 [ \(9.0,9.5\) ]、[ \(9.5,10.0\) ]、[ \(10.0,10.5\) ]、[ \(10.5,11.0\) ] 和 \(>11.0\) 。水平红线将 \(\mu_{*}>1:4\) 的大质量合并与 \(1:10<\mu_{*}<1:4\) 的小质量合并分开。每个子样本中的合并数量由黑色注释标出。

figures.caption_en: Table 1: Input and target features for the random forest regression used in this work. The input features consist of various merger properties, and the target feature is the post-merger morphology (see text for detailed definitions). After training, the random forest regression yields the relative importance of each input feature in predicting the target, enabling a direct comparison of how individual merger properties affect the post-merger morphology.
figures.caption_zh: 表1：本工作中用于随机森林回归的输入和目标特征。输入特征包括各种合并属性，目标特征是合并后形态（详细定义见正文）。训练后，随机森林回归得出每个输入特征在预测目标时的相对重要性，从而可以直接比较各个合并属性对合并后形态的影响。

figures.caption_en: Figure 2: Feature importances of various merger properties obtained from the random forest regression, for the last major merger events at \(z 95 (see their Figure 7).
figures.caption_zh: 图2：随机森林回归得到的各种合并属性的特征重要性，针对 \(z 95\) 处的最后一次大质量合并事件（见其图7）。

figures.caption_en: Figure 3: Feature importance of various merger properties in predicting the post-merger morphology for (a) major mergers, and (b) minor mergers. Similar to Fig. 2 . In each panel, different colored lines represent the results for different pre-merger stellar mass bins. For reference, the black dashed line in panel (a) gives the result for the last major mergers of massive galaxies, identical to that shown in Fig. 2 . For both major and minor mergers across all stellar mass ranges, only three properties have a considerable influence on the post-merger morphology: collision angle \(\overline{\theta}\) , pre-merger morphology \({(B/T)_{*,pre}}\) , and cold gas fraction \(f_{{cold\,gas}}\) . Together, these three properties primarily determine the post-merger galaxy morphology, with the relative importance varying across different merger ratios and stellar masses.
figures.caption_zh: 图3：预测合并后形态时各种合并属性的特征重要性，分别针对 (a) 大质量合并和 (b) 小质量合并。类似于图2。在每个面板中，不同颜色的线代表不同合并前恒星质量区间的结果。作为参考，面板(a)中的黑色虚线给出了大质量星系最后一次大质量合并的结果，与图2所示相同。对于所有恒星质量范围内的大质量和小质量合并，只有三个属性对合并后形态有显著影响：碰撞角 \(\overline{\theta}\)、合并前形态 \({(B/T)_{*,pre}}\) 和冷气体比例 \(f_{{cold\,gas}}\)。这三个属性共同主要决定合并后星系形态，其相对重要性随合并比和恒星质量的不同而变化。

figures.caption_en: Figure 4: Dependence of galaxy post-merger morphology on the three key merger properties, \({(B/T)_{*,pre}}\) , \(\overline{\theta}\) , and \(f_{{cold\,gas}}\) , in major mergers of five different mass bins. Upper panels: The horizontal and vertical axes represent pre-merger morphology \({(B/T)_{*,pre}}\) versus post-merger morphology \({(B/T)_{*,post}}\) , with symbols color-coded by the collision angle \(\overline{\theta}\) . Bluer colors indicate more spiral-in mergers, while redder colors represent more head-on mergers. Bottom panels: The horizontal and vertical axes show \(\overline{\theta}\) versus \({(B/T)_{*,post}}\) , with symbols color-coded by the cold gas fraction \(f_{{cold\,gas}}\) . Bluer colors indicate more cold gas-rich mergers, whereas redder colors indicate more cold gas-poor mergers. This figure shows that for major mergers, \(\overline{\theta}\) is the primary determinant of the post-merger morphology, with spiral-in orbits producing disk galaxies, while head-on orbits yield ellipticals. The sub-dominant features are \(f_{{cold\,gas}}\) , which further promotes disk formation in low-mass galaxy mergers where it is abundant, and \({(B/T)_{*,pre}}\) , which helps preserve pre-existing structure in massive galaxies.
figures.caption_zh: 图4：在五个不同质量区间的大质量合并中，星系合并后形态对三个关键合并属性 \({(B/T)_{*,pre}}\)、\(\overline{\theta}\) 和 \(f_{{cold\,gas}}\) 的依赖性。上面板：横轴和纵轴分别表示合并前形态 \({(B/T)_{*,pre}}\) 与合并后形态 \({(B/T)_{*,post}}\)，符号颜色表示碰撞角 \(\overline{\theta}\)。蓝色表示更螺旋式的合并，红色表示更正面的合并。下面板：横轴和纵轴分别表示 \(\overline{\theta}\) 与 \({(B/T)_{*,post}}\)，符号颜色表示冷气体比例 \(f_{{cold\,gas}}\)。蓝色表示更富含冷气体的合并，红色表示更贫冷气体的合并。该图显示，对于大质量合并，\(\overline{\theta}\) 是合并后形态的主要决定因素，螺旋式轨道产生盘星系，而正面轨道产生椭圆星系。次要特征是 \(f_{{cold\,gas}}\)，在低质量星系合并中，冷气体丰富时进一步促进盘形成；以及 \({(B/T)_{*,pre}}\)，有助于在质量星系中保留已有结构。

figures.caption_en: Figure 5: Similar to Fig. 4 , but for minor mergers in different mass bins. For minor mergers, the general trends for dependence of the post-merger morphology on \(\overline{\theta}\) , \({(B/T)_{*,pre}}\) and \(f_{{cold\,gas}}\) are similar to those for major mergers, except that the dependence is stronger on \({(B/T)_{*,pre}}\) and weaker on \(\overline{\theta}\) .
figures.caption_zh: 图5：类似于图4，但针对不同质量区间的小质量合并。对于小质量合并，合并后形态对 \(\overline{\theta}\)、\({(B/T)_{*,pre}}\) 和 \(f_{{cold\,gas}}\) 的依赖趋势与大质量合并相似，不同之处在于对 \({(B/T)_{*,pre}}\) 的依赖性更强，而对 \(\overline{\theta}\) 的依赖性更弱。

figures.caption_en: Figure 6: A typical case of a cold gas-rich ( \(f_{{cold\,gas}}=0.65\) ) major merger ( \(\mu_{*}=0.37\) ) with a spiral-in orbit ( \(\overline{\theta}=70.47^{\circ}\) ), illustrating how cold gas and collision angle affect the galaxy morphological transformation. The upper rows show the density projections of stars (red) and gas (blue) before the merger, viewed from two directions: the \(x^{\prime}-y^{\prime}\) and \(x^{\prime}-z^{\prime}\) projection planes correspond to viewing angles perpendicular and parallel to the merger orbital plane, respectively. The merger orbit of this case is indicated by the gray dashed lines, and various properties before merger are also labeled. In bottom rows, the left panels show the density projections of stars and gas after the merger. In addition, the right panels show the density projections of the stars newly formed during the merger and of the pre-existing stars, with their mass fractions and \({B/T}\) values labeled.
figures.caption_zh: 图6：一个典型的冷气体丰富 ( \(f_{{cold\,gas}}=0.65\) ) 的大质量合并 ( \(\mu_{*}=0.37\) ) 且螺旋式轨道 ( \(\overline{\theta}=70.47^{\circ}\) ) 的案例，说明冷气体和碰撞角如何影响星系形态转变。上面几行显示合并前恒星（红色）和气体（蓝色）的密度投影，从两个方向观察：\(x^{\prime}-y^{\prime}\) 和 \(x^{\prime}-z^{\prime}\) 投影平面分别对应于垂直于和平行于合并轨道平面的视角。该案例的合并轨道由灰色虚线表示，合并前的各种属性也已标注。在下面几行中，左侧面板显示合并后恒星和气体的密度投影。此外，右侧面板显示合并期间新形成的恒星和已有恒星的密度投影，并标注了它们的质量比例和 \({B/T}\) 值。
